scope: Uncounted research candidates; not editorial acceptance or runtime testing.
method: First 50 star-sorted GitHub search results per query; one query per topic; not exhaustive or a quality ranking. Follow-up 2026-10-28: 17 targeted canonical repository lookups, six existing-candidate reviews and two primary-topic corrections; the original broad-query snapshot remains dated per topic. Sector discovery 2026-10-28: six additional proposed topics, 32 bounded search retrievals with 484 returned observations before cross-query deduplication and selection, and 26 unseen candidates. The earlier 70-topic snapshot was not rerun.
url_resolution: data_path is relative to the repository root at the same branch or commit.
